integrity: The proof is analytic. The source-dependent premises—the generator convention, semistar-to-vertex correspondence, and equivalence of vertex-transitivity with root-system generators—were checked in the full text of the primary source. The Euclidean inradius and circumradius conclusions are then derived from support inequalities, Weyl-chamber sign patterns, simplicial cone geometry, and central symmetry; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to full-dimensional vertex-transitive zonotopes and uses the Euclidean metric. It does not classify all possible incenters when the largest inscribed ball has nonunique centers, and it does not extend the formula to arbitrary non-vertex-transitive zonotopes. The literature search leaves a residual risk of an equivalent formula stated under a different Coxeter-polytope normalization.
title: Exact Euclidean radii and tangent facets of vertex-transitive zonotopes
